title: Burn my Shallow Ground declares war on inner battles with new single “My Fight Begins”
htmlContent: In their fourth release of 2025, Burn my Shallow Ground is sharing something powerful with their new single, “My Fight Begins.” It crashes in with an intense energy that demands attention. This song marks an important moment for the band in the world of industrial metal, delivering an emotional punch that feels raw and powerful. The track was produced by Daniel Graves, known for his work with Aesthetic Perfection, and mastered in Hamburg. The combination of skillful production and heartfelt expression creates a sound that is both grand and deeply personal. Listeners are immersed in a powerful mix of driving drums, intense synthesizers, and passionate vocals that capture deep emotions. “My Fight Begins” confronts tough personal struggles, it’s like a battle cry emerging from the depths of pain. Themes of grief, trauma, and chaos are brought out into the open, not to be avoided, but confronted with strength and determination. This song is about feeling hopeless and about rising and reclaiming one’s voice amidst the wreckage. There’s a relatable humanity in all this intensity, a genuine vulnerability woven into the lyrics and vocals. https://open.spotify.com/track/54zBBaxtlixMECUWmAtStj The emotions feel authentic and deeply felt, not just acted out. This sincerity, paired with top-notch production, makes the song resonate powerfully, hitting listeners not only in their hearts but also in their minds. “My Fight Begins” is a powerful statement. It represents a call to action against silence and oppression. Burn my Shallow Ground is demanding attention, and with this release, they’ve truly earned it. As the final notes of the track fade away, this is just the start. And the journey? It’s far from over.
